result.description:
Heavy Diesel Plant Mechanic | Boilermaker

Force Equipment, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Emeco Group, is seeking suitably experienced and qualified trades personnel to join our workshop teams. These teams are focused on the inspection, overhaul, rebuild, and repair of heavy mobile equipment components, supporting high-quality, reliable outcomes for our mining customers through industry-leading workshop facilities and systems.

Reporting to the Workshop Supervisor, you will be responsible for maintaining Force (and customer) equipment / machines ensuring availability / integrity, successful candidates will be responsible for: 

•	Focus on safe working environment and quality of workmanship. 
•	Major customer machine rebuilds carried out in the workshop
•	Ongoing repairs and maintenance of in-house and customer equipment
o	Maintenance and repairs on Caterpillar, Liebherr, Elphinstone, Sandvik, Atlas Copco - Epiroc, Hitachi and Komatsu mobile equipment    within budgets and time frames
o	Working with the Force Equipment customers to meet their company objectives; and
o	Quality control on all work performed. 

Your Skills and Experience:
•	Nationally recognised trade qualification
•	Experience with heavy earthmoving equipment
•	A strong commitment to safety
•	Good analytical and problem-solving skills with a solution focus
•	A keen eye for detail, presentation and craftsmanship; and
•	The ability to work as part of a cohesive team

We Offer 
•	Opportunity to grow and develop through training and future career opportunities
•	Competitive hourly rates
•	Variety of work; and
•	Permanent employment

About you
•	Australian recognised trade certificate
•	Demonstrated experience in servicing, repair and component change outs across a variety of mobile earthmoving equipment.

How to apply
Contact Nat on 0497 348 512 or natalie.marley@emecogroup.com for more info or click on 'Apply' and upload your CV today!
Emeco Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer - we encourage applicants who identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander to apply.

To learn more about Force job opportunities: https://forceequipment.com.au/careers

Force is a member of the Emeco Group. Emeco was founded in 1972 and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX: EHL). We have operations in all key mining regions of Australia and our customers include mining companies and contractors across coal, gold, copper, bauxite and iron ore.

result.description:
Immediate start
Lots of overtime
Mackay based – home every night

ABC Heavy Engineering are seeking to employ suitably qualified Welders to join our busy team of professionals working out of our Paget depot.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics
We are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer, where all applicants are treated with fairness and respect and have equal access to all opportunities available. At ABC Heavy Engineering, diversity is about creating a respectful and inclusive workplace that recognises the unique contributions and perspectives of our employees, working together to deliver extraordinary results.

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Maintenance Supervisor – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $100,000 – $130,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Maintenance Supervisor to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Maintenance Supervisor, you will be responsible for supervising maintenance personnel and coordinating preventative, corrective, and shutdown maintenance activities across mining, industrial, and heavy engineering projects. You will ensure maintenance work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with company procedures, client requirements, and Australian Standards.
Key Responsibilities
•	Supervise and coordinate daily maintenance activities across workshop and site operations.
•	Plan, schedule, and oversee preventative, corrective, and breakdown maintenance on plant, equipment, and machinery.
•	Allocate work to maintenance personnel and monitor productivity and work quality.
•	Ensure maintenance work is completed safely, on time, and within budget.
•	Inspect equipment and maintenance work to ensure compliance with engineering specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements.
•	Liaise with project managers, engineers, clients, and other departments to coordinate maintenance schedules and project requirements.
•	Investigate equipment failures, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to minimise downtime.
•	Monitor maintenance records, service schedules, work orders, and equipment history.
•	Coordinate procurement of spare parts, tools, and maintenance materials as required.
•	Mentor, train, and support maintenance personnel, apprentices, and contractors.
•	Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety policies, environmental requirements, and company procedures.
•	Prepare maintenance reports, performance metrics, and recommendations for continuous improvement.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1-2 years of full-time experience in a Maintenance Supervisor or similar maintenance leadership role.
•	Strong knowledge of preventative and corrective maintenance practices for industrial or mining equipment.
•	Experience supervising tradespeople in mining, oil and gas, fabrication, heavy engineering, or industrial environments.
•	Ability to interpret engineering drawings, maintenance manuals, and technical documentation.
•	Strong leadership, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
•	Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
•	Proficiency in maintenance management systems and Microsoft Office applications.
•	Strong commitment to workplace safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $100,000 – $130,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

## ICT Quality Assurance Engineer
## Position Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced ICT Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team and play a pivotal role in upholding the integrity and performance of our computer systems and environments. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing robust quality assurance frameworks that ensure compliance with both internal policies and external industry standards. You will work closely with technical teams and stakeholders to identify risks, drive continuous improvement, and embed a culture of quality across the organisation. This position is well suited to a methodical and proactive professional with a strong background in ICT systems, auditing, and quality governance.
## Key Responsibilities
- Plan, schedule, and conduct thorough quality audit inspections of ICT systems, data, documentation, and operational processes to assess functionality, efficiency, and compliance.
- Analyse audit findings to identify variations, irregularities, and potential high-risk areas that may compromise adherence to established standards and procedures.
- Develop and recommend corrective action plans to address non-compliance, driving timely resolution and measurable improvements across systems and processes.
- Establish, maintain, and continuously improve quality assurance frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned with accredited internal and external industry standards.
- Evaluate the functional performance, validity, and business value of ICT systems and environments, providing evidence-based recommendations to stakeholders.
- Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and operations teams to integrate quality assurance practices throughout the software and systems development lifecycle.
- Communicate and liaise with end users, technical staff, and management to promote awareness of quality standards, procedural requirements, and compliance obligations.
- Design and execute structured test plans, test cases, and testing strategies to validate system performance and identify defects prior to deployment.
- Monitor ongoing processes and systems to proactively detect quality issues and ensure sustained adherence to regulatory and organisational requirements.
- Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of audit activities, test results, findings, and corrective actions for reporting and governance purposes.
- Provide guidance, mentoring, and oversight to junior QA staff or ICT quality assurance team members where required.
- Contribute to risk assessments and the development of quality improvement initiatives that support organisational objectives and ICT strategy.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in an ICT quality assurance, systems auditing, or related technical role within a complex organisational environment.
- Proven ability to plan and conduct quality audits, analyse system and process data, and produce clear, actionable reports.
- Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, including functional, regression, integration, and performance testing.
- Strong knowledge of quality management principles and frameworks such as ISO 9001, ITIL, or equivalent standards.
- Experience developing and maintaining QA documentation including test plans, test cases, procedures, and audit reports.
- Proficiency with QA tools and technologies relevant to ICT environments, such as defect tracking, test management, or automation platforms.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), or ISO Lead Auditor.
- Experience working within Agile or DevOps delivery environments and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and associated quality practices.
- Exposure to automation testing tools such as Selenium, Postman, or similar platforms.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and data governance practices relevant to ICT quality and compliance.
- Familiarity with Australian government or industry-specific ICT compliance requirements and regulatory environments.
- Prior experience in a supervisory or team lead capacity within a QA function.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that genuinely values quality, innovation, and continuous improvement in everything it delivers.
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options, designed to support a healthy work-life balance.
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and career progression pathways.
- Contribute to meaningful and impactful ICT projects that make a real difference to the organisation and the communities it serves.
- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits and a supportive workplace culture that champions diversity and inclusion.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Riggers to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Rigger, you will be responsible for planning, preparing, and performing rigging operations to safely lift, move, position, and secure heavy machinery, structural steel, equipment, and materials across mining, oil & gas, construction, and industrial projects. You will work closely with crane operators, engineers, supervisors, and other trades to ensure lifting activities are carried out safely and efficiently in accordance with Australian Standards and site requirements.

Key Responsibilities
•	Read and interpret lifting plans, engineering drawings, and work instructions.
•	Plan and perform rigging operations for lifting, positioning, and installation of heavy equipment and structural components.
•	Select, inspect, and safely use lifting gear, including slings, chains, wire ropes, shackles, spreader bars, lifting beams, and hoists.
•	Direct crane operators using standard hand signals and radio communications during lifting operations.
•	Assemble, dismantle, align, and secure heavy machinery, plant, structural steel, and industrial equipment.
•	Conduct pre-start inspections of rigging equipment and ensure all lifting gear is certified and fit for use.
•	Identify hazards, assess lifting risks, and implement appropriate control measures.
•	Assist with shutdowns, maintenance projects, equipment installations, and major construction activities.
•	Maintain accurate records of lifting equipment inspections and completed work where required.
•	Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, crane operators, and other trades to ensure projects are completed safely and on schedule.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety policies, procedures, and environmental requirements.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Rigger in mining, construction, or heavy industrial environments.
•	Current High Risk Work Licence – Rigging (Basic, Intermediate, or Advanced).
•	Strong knowledge of lifting techniques, rigging equipment, and safe lifting practices.
•	Ability to read and interpret lifting plans, engineering drawings, and technical specifications.
•	Experience working with cranes, heavy equipment, structural steel, and mechanical installations.
•	Strong commitment to workplace safety and compliance with Australian Standards.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
